content.title: International Airline Program | Discount Airfares
content.text: I. The International Airline Program (the “Program”) offers preferential fares on participating airlines to holders of an eligible Basic and Supplementary American Express Platinum Card as described in your American Express Welcome Brochure or are otherwise identified to you by American Express (“Eligible Cardmember”). In order to take advantage of the Program, the Eligible Cardmember’s account must be active (meaning not cancelled). II. Other restrictions may apply. For additional details including participating airlines and additional terms, conditions and restrictions, and to book travel please call Platinum Card Travel Service at 1-800-419-1255. III. Eligible routes, class of service, code-share arrangements, designated gateways and similar matters relating to travel in the Program are determined by and will vary by airline. IV. The Program is valid for travel booked and/or completed within designated dates. Designated dates are subject to change without notice and are updated based on arrangements with participating airlines from time to time. V. All Program bookings and purchases must be made through American Express Travel Services of American Express (India) Pvt Ltd.. A travel service fee per booking may apply. VI. The Program is subject to availability on the participating airlines’ eligible flights. Participating airlines may have limited seat allocations and destinations in respect of the Program and may have other terms, conditions, exclusions, restrictions and fees. Eligible class(es) of service are determined by each participating airline. VII. Ticketing is based on Fare rules of the participating airlines, and the corresponding fare class in which the ticket is booked. VIII. Tickets issued for this Program cannot be transferred or endorsed. Full-fare ticket and the associated discounted fare tickets, must be issued at the same time, for the same itinerary, with departure and return on the same flights and in the same class of service. All tickets are subject to all applicable government fees, taxes and charges including airport levies. Once issued, names cannot be changed. Passengers and companions under the Program must travel together. IX. This Program cannot be combined with any other promotion, travel agent discount, consolidator fares, travel industry and airline employee discounts, child, infant or senior citizen fare, frequent flyer award, group rate, corporate rate, MCOs, or any other promotional offer. X. We reserve the right to cancel or change the Program in whole or in part or change the terms and conditions of the Program at any time, for any reason and without notice. Participating airlines are subject to change without notice. Under no circumstances will American Express or any of their affiliates be liable for any loss or damage howsoever incurred as a result of the termination of the Program, the termination of any participating airline or any change in the Program XI. All recourse for any and all liability in connection with full-fare, special class fare tickets, discounted fare tickets and/or upgrade tickets issued under the Program, the refusal to issue or honour any such tickets, travel pursuant to any such tickets or the failure of any participating airline or other party to adhere to the terms of the Program is as against the relevant participating airline only. Under no circumstances will American Express Bankig Corp. or any of their affiliates be liable for any conduct, action or failure of any participating airline whatsoever, including, without limitation, for any expense, loss, injury (to person or property), damage, delay, flight cancellation, denied boarding, missed connection, accident or any other matter whatsoever, however suffered or caused, directly or indirectly in connection with tickets, transportation or other services provided or refused to be provided by any participating airline or other party. To the extent permitted by applicable law, American Express Banking Corp. or any of their affiliates will not be liable for any incidental, indirect, consequential, special, punitive or exemplary damages of any kind whatsoever arising from or in connection with the Program (whether in contract, tort, strict liability, products liability or otherwise), including, without limitation, lost revenues, loss of profits or loss or interruption of business. XII. Your journey must start and end at the same port as designated by the participating airline and be completed within the period during which your selected airline participates in the programme. You will be advised of any applicable dates at the time of booking. XIII. IAP tickets must be purchased through the American Express Travel Service and must be charged to a valid Indian American Express Platinum Card which is in good standing. XIV. The Platinum Member who purchases the ticket(s) must be one of the travelers. XV. IAP tickets are non-transferable and non-endorsable. XVI. A maximum of 8 tickets can be purchased per cardmember per transaction.
